chapter.verse: Paul in upate a tel takpi-in en a, “Ute naute aw, tuni dongin Pasian mai-ah keimah pumpi ka kimawhsak nading om loin ka om hi,” a cih ciangin
siampi mangpa Ananias in, “Ama muk sat un,” ci-in a kiangah a dingte thu a pia hi.

Tua ciangin Paul in, “Leikang tawh kizut suangcian’ aw, Pasian in nang hong sat ding hi. Nang in Thukham tawh kei tungah thukhen dingin na tu napi-in, Thukham tawh kibang loin hong sat ding thu na pia hiam?” a ci hi.
A kiangah a ding mite in zong, “Nang in Pasian’ siampi mangpa zahko na hi hiam?” a cih uh ciangin,
Paul in, “Ute naute aw, amah in Pasian’ siampi mangpa ahih lam ka thei kei hi. ‘No mipawlte a uk mangpa na kosia kei ding hi,’ ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh zo hi,” a ci hi..

Upa kimkhat Farisai-te, kimkhat Saddusi-te ahih uh Paul in a theih ciangin, “Ute naute aw, Farisai mi ka hi hi. Farisai’ ta ka hi hi. Mi sisate hong thokik ding hi ci-in ka lamet hangin thu dotna ka thuak hi,” ci-in upate kiangah a ko hi.
Paul in tua thu a gen ciangin Farisai-te leh Saddusi-te khat leh khat kiseel uh ahih ciangin a kikhawmte a kikhen uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Saddusi-te in, “Hin’kikna ahi zongin, vantungmi ahi zongin, kha ahi zongin a om kei hi,” a ci uh hi. Farisai-te in ahih leh, a nihin a om uh hi a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin gamlumna piang a, Farisai-te laka laitheite kimkhat ding-in nakpi-in a nial uh a, “Hih pa tungah bangmah mawhna ka mu kei uh hi. Kha ahi zongin, vantungmi ahi zongin ama kiangah a gen leh, bang phamawh ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Kiseelna a tam ciangin amaute in Paul a sukgawp khak ding uh galkap mangpa lunghimawh ahih ciangin, galkapte paisakin Paul amaute lak pan zawhthawh thu-in la a, galkap innah a paipih dingun a sawl hi.
Zing nitak ciangin Topa in Paul kiangah ding a, “Paul aw, lunghimawh kei in. Keima thu Jerusalem khua-ah na gen zo hi. Tua mah bangin Rom khua-ah zong ka teci thu na pang lai ding hi,” a ci hi.
Khua a vak ciangin Judah mite kikhawm uh a, “Paul i thah khit matengin an i ne kei ding hi, tui i dawn kei ding hi,” ci-in a kiciam uh hi.
Tua banga a kiciamte a kisim ciangin sawmli val pha hi.
Tua mite in siampi liante leh upate kiangah a pai uh a, “Kote in Paul ka thah khit matengun bangmah ka ne kei ding uh hi ci-in ka kiciam uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin note in upa vaihawmte tawh Paul thu a pha takpi khen ding bangin a hong paipihsuk nadingun galkap mangpa kiangah na ngen un. Paul in note kiangah hong tun’ ma-in lam kalah that dingin ka omkhol ding uh hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Paul’ sanggamnu’ tapa in tuate lampi kiangah pangin a om uh cih a theih ciangin, galkap inn sungah lut a, Paul kiangah a zasak hi.
Paul in galkap khat sam a, “Hih tangval galkap mangpa kiangah va kha in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, thugen ding khat a nei hi,” a ci hi.
Galkap bupa in tangvalpa pen galkap mangpa kiangah paipih a, “A kikhum Paul in kei hong sam a, ‘Mangpa kiangah koh nop a nei hih tangvalpa nang kiangah va paipih in,’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi.
Galkap mangpa in tangvalpa’ khut lenin, a kilang lona-ah paipih a, “Bang thu hong ko nuam na hi hiam? ci-in a dong sim hi.
Tangvalpa in, “Zing ciangin upa kikhopna-ah Paul hong paipihsuk a, Judah mite in ama thu tel takin a dong ding bangin, nang kiangah hong ngen dingin a vaihawm zo uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amau deihna bangin zui kei in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, Paul a thah khit matengun an ne lo, tui dawn lo ding ci-in a kiciam mi sawmli val lampi gei-ah a ding uh hi. Tu-in tuate in amau thu na man’ ding a ngak uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin galkap mangpa in, “Nang in kei kiangah hih thu nong gen kuamah na gen kei in,” ci-in tangvalpa thu pia-in a khah hi.

Tangval a ciah khit ciangin galkap mangpa in galkap bupa sam a, “Tu nitak nai kua ciangin Kaisaria khua pai dingin galkap zanih tawh, sakol tuang galkap sawmsagih tawh, teipi tawi galkap zanih tawh kithawisak in.
Paul tuan’ nading sakolte pia in. Mangpipa Feliks kiangah pha takpi-in a paipih ding uh hi,” ci-in thu a pia hi.
Amah in hih bangin lai a gelhinah:
“Klaudis Lisias in Mangpipa Feliks kiangah lungdamna lai kong khak hi.
Judah mite in hih pa a man uh a, a that ding a kisak lai takun, amah in Rom mi ahih thu ka theih ciangin galkapte tawh pai-in, amah ka honkhia hi.
Amaute in bang hangin a mawhsak uh hiam cih ka thei nuam a, amaute upa vaihawmte kiangah ka paipihsuk hi.
A kithahna ding ahi zongin, thong sungah a kikhum nading ahi zongin a kilawm a khialhna hang ahi lo, amau thukham thu bek in a mawhsak uh hi cih ka thei hi.
Tua pa bawlsia dingin amaute a hanciam thu hong kizaksak ciangin, thakhatin kong paisak a, amah mawhsakte in nangma kiangah hong ko dingin thu ka pia zo hi,” ci-in a gelh hi.
Tua ciangin galkap mangpa’ vaikhak bangin galkapte in Paul a la uh a, zan lai takin Antipatris khua-ah a tung uh hi.
A zing ciangin sakol galkapte in Paul paipih uh a, galkapte a ciah uh hi.
Sakol tuang galkapte in Kaisaria khua-ah a tun’ uh ciangin, Mangpipa’ khut tungah lai a pia uh hi. Paul zong Mangpipa mai-ah a koih uh hi.
Mangpipa in lai a sim ciangin, “Kua gam mi na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot leh, Kilikia gam mi ahih a theih ciangin,
“Nang hong mawhsakte hong tun’ uh ciangin, na thu ka ngai ding hi,” ci-in Herod’ kumpi-inn ah khum dingin thu a pia hi.
